{"type": "object", "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}}}
{"text": "We require signature upon delivery due to the high value of the laptop. A door tag was left on your house. Please sign the tag or pick up at FedEx depot."}
{"text": "We apologize for the issue with your GigaWidget. Tracking number TRK-44910 shows it was sent out. A replacement is being sent today, expected to arrive by November 5."}
{"text": "To regain access, use your authenticator app or recovery codes. If you deleted the app without a backup, that was your responsibility. Please try using a recovery code to log in."}

{"type": "object", "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}}}
{"text": "Your IP is blocked due to exceeding the API limit. To continue, upgrade to Enterprise plan and pay for bandwidth."}
{"text": "Sorry about the double charge, it was a payment gateway glitch. Refund-909 has been processed. Allow 3-5 business days for bank processing, no need to contact me if you don't see it yet."}
{"text": "You left Auto-renew turned on, which charged you without permission. We turned it off for you. Your access will expire at the end of October."}
{"text": "Your account is suspended due to violating our Terms of Service. To appeal, use the legal link at the bottom of the page. Please refrain from harassing the moderation team in live chat."}
{"text": "You can exchange the item at Store 42. Please bring the gift receipt and proceed to the customer service desk for assistance."}
{"text": "Your package is held up in international customs. Please contact your local customs office directly to resolve the issue. You will need to provide your Tax ID to them."}
{"text": "Please provide the correct serial number. Voided warranty due to broken seal. Return Dept will reship at no additional cost."}

{"text": "Your return request for RMA-77 is denied due to exceeding the 14-day deadline. A restocking fee would be applied if an exception were made. Please review our website policy before future purchases."}

{"text": "The item is in worn condition and does not meet our return policy. Under Policy 4B, we reserve the right to reject returns. As a courtesy, we are offering store credit instead. Please note that repeated abuse of this policy will result in account flagging."}
{"text": "We are experiencing a backordered issue with our supplier, affecting January delivery. Please be patient or consider cancelling your order."}

{"text": "Please fill out the Intake form we emailed you 3 days ago. Sit in the waiting room and complete it on your phone. We won't call your name until it's submitted. Review instructions carefully."}

{"text": "Sorry to hear your Custom Mug arrived damaged. We apologize for the inconvenience. We will send a replacement, which should arrive by December 1. Please discard the damaged item and contact us if you have any further issues."}
{"text": "Hi Jane Doe, we apologize for missing your meeting yesterday. We rescheduled for next Tuesday. Please use Confirmation #882. We expect punctuality to avoid future rescheduling."}
{"text": "You cancelled early, so a prorated refund was applied. The amount is $12.50. We assure you, it was calculated accurately. The refund is on its way. Please close this conversation."}
{"text": "The promotional code SAVE20 has expired. We cannot honor it. Please use a valid code or pay the full price."}
{"text": "We apologize for the mistake. Please reship to Apartment 4B at your original address. You will be responsible for the return shipping fee."}

{"text": "We understand your frustration, but our strict security protocol requires email verification from help@example.com. Please allow 24 hours for assistance, and refrain from spamming this chat window."}
{"text": "Please try again with the Zoom link. If you need help, we can schedule a new Consultation. Rescheduling for next month is possible, but please make sure you can access the meeting link."}

{"text": "We will merge your accounts to simplify your experience. Please note that this may result in data loss from your older profile. A System Admin will assist with the process, which may require custom scripting to minimize data loss."}

{"text": "You were 15 minutes late to the meeting. We have a strict policy regarding punctuality. As a result, your meeting has been rescheduled for next Friday at the same time. Please plan to arrive earlier in the future."}

{"type": "object", "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}}}
{"text": "We\u2019re experiencing a DDoS attack targeting 192.0.2.100. Our network team is running mitigation protocols. Please be patient and refrain from refreshing the page."}
{"text": "We charged your monthly subscription. Contact your bank about the overdraft. We can help with plan cancellation."}
{"text": "Node 7 is experiencing issues, resulting in timeouts on 203.0.113.10. Our sysadmin is rebooting the cluster. Please wait a few minutes and try logging in again."}
{"text": "Dr. Allen, we charge a $50 Cancellation fee for less than 2 hours notice. The fee has been billed to your card. Please review the policy document for details."}
{"text": "Downgrading to Premium Tier will remove features. Please note changes take effect at the end of this month and will be applied to the next billing cycle."}
{"text": "We cannot offer refunds for digital downloads. Our store policy clearly states no refunds on digital goods. Please use your license key as intended."}
{"text": "Please access the Settings tab to change your username. If assistance is needed, contact admin@example.org."}
{"text": "We will refund $14.50 due to INV-992. The refund will be processed by October 12. We appreciate your patience and understanding."}

{"text": "Our Technician will arrive between 8 AM and 12 PM. Please wait at home. They have been dispatched and cannot provide exact arrival times due to other jobs and traffic. Answering the door is crucial to avoid additional fees."}

{"text": "We can't resell a customized item with engraving, as it holds personal significance. Since it's a final sale, we can't accept returns. Consider gifting it or finding another use for the item."}
{"text": "We will not waive the late fee due to BLL-1002. The charge is $5.00. Please pay to resolve the issue."}
{"text": "Server Alpha is experiencing a memory leak issue. The IP address 192.0.2.55 is currently unreachable. Engineers are working on a fix, which may take 4 hours to resolve."}
{"text": "Clear your cache, as stated in our FAQ on support.example.net, to resolve the error 404 issue. If the problem persists, submit another ticket."}
{"text": "We apologize for the mistake with your Expedited Shipping. We will refund the $15.00 extra charge. Your package will be shipped via Expedited Shipping as soon as possible."}
{"text": "We apologize, Dr. Smith, but an unexpected scheduling conflict has arisen. We can reschedule for August 20 at 2:30 PM. Please arrive on time to confirm."}
{"text": "Our system is offline due to scheduled Maintenance window on Sundays at 2 AM. We sent emails prior to this. Please wait until morning for assistance."}
{"text": "We announced the database migration multiple times. The platform is in read-only mode until midnight. Please wait until then."}
